name: local-skills
description: Choose which skill folders on your computer reach your agents' sandbox and your library. Nothing is shared until you turn it on.

settings.label: Extra agent skill folders
settings.help: Folders under your home where another agent CLI reads skills, one per line (such as ~/.mytool/skills). A skill linked from one is placed there in your sandbox too.

settings.label: Never copy
settings.help: Name patterns never copied into your sandbox or library, one per line (such as *.log), added to the component's own.

settings.label: Secret file names
settings.help: Name patterns of files that hold credentials, one per line (such as *.secret); a skill holding one is never shared. Added to the component's own.

settings.label: Secret patterns
settings.help: Regular expressions (Go syntax) of text that marks a credential, one per line; added to the component's own.

settings.label: Skills in a sandbox
settings.help: How many skills one member's sandbox takes at most. Empty keeps the component's own limit.
